name: psychology
description: Connect Psychology to distil the memories and past chats you choose, surface candidate patterns and likely answers, and ask only about consequential gaps. Also supports non-clinical, source-aware self-reflection.

interface.shortDescription: Distil the memories and past chats you choose; explore patterns and likely answers, then fill only real gaps.
interface.longDescription: Start with relevant memories and past chats the current assistant can access, or selected conversations you choose to share. Psychology distils goal-relevant strengths, patterns, and likely answers, grounded in examples, then asks only about gaps that could change what comes next. It calls out unavailable sources and does not claim access to another account's archive. The hosted MCP uses OAuth. Supported hosts have a recorded host-specific acceptance result; stored Noesis data is read only after an explicit source choice and applicable consent. Psychology supports reflection, not diagnosis or treatment.
defaultPrompt: Before drafting, actively use any built-in memory or past-chat retrieval this assistant exposes to find goal-relevant context; do not treat the current chat or Noesis guide as a search of my history. Do not ask me to paste history before trying available retrieval; if none is exposed or it finds nothing relevant, say so briefly and continue with selected or current-chat context. Use the memories and past chats you can access to distil strengths and likely answers for my goal, grounded in examples. For each pattern or likely answer, cite the accessible source platform and source type, plus a visible conversation title, stable reference, or link when available. Mark unavailable source references or dates as unknown; do not invent them. For a changing claim, show known event/statement time, memory saved/updated time, summary-generation time, and applicability period separately. Use Noesis receipt time only for a reviewed selection that actually has one. Before drafting, call psychology_get_profile_distillation_guide once; if the tool is unavailable or the call fails, say so plainly and continue with accessible context, asking no more than three consequential follow-up questions. For time-sensitive goals and preferences, distinguish source event or statement time, memory save/update time, summary-generation time, when the claim applied, and when Noesis received a reviewed selection; a recent summary does not make an old goal current. Apply explicit current-session corrections before deciding whether an old claim remains unresolved; a direct correction resolves it for this conversation, so do not repeat the question or recommend a direction based on the superseded claim. The correction does not establish when the prior claim stopped applying; leave an unstated historical boundary unknown and do not backdate it. Ask whether an old goal still applies only if its current status remains unresolved after applying current-session evidence and the answer could change the next step. For ordinary first-use distillation, do not call other Noesis tools, save profile data, or claim permission/data checks. Do not offer persistence unless I explicitly ask. If I explicitly ask to use my selected Noesis imports, first call psychology_get_consent_status. If conversation_import_authorized is not true, stop and ask me to enable that purpose in Noesis. If authorized, call psychology_list_my_selected_context_grants and show only the active grants it returns for this connection, including each returned grant's purpose, categories, date range, time_basis, date semantics, and expiry. If the grant-list tool is unavailable or fails, stop; do not read imported context. Ask me to select one of those exact returned grants before reading. If no active grant is returned, stop and ask me to create one in Noesis. After I select a returned grant, call psychology_get_my_selected_import_context with exactly its purpose as agent_purpose, categories as category_filter, date_range_start and date_range_end as date_from and date_to, and time_basis as time_basis. Preserve the returned dates and time basis exactly. Never invent, alter, combine, broaden, or retry a grant scope. If the grant expires, consent is withdrawn, or the read is rejected, stop and ask me to configure a new exact grant; do not try another grant without asking. This reads only selected entries for this current connection, never a full account archive. If I separately request a profile save, show me the exact fields, obtain my final confirmation, and require current profile consent and the age gate before calling the save tool. The service appends the profile immediately; say it was saved only when the tool returns saved=true. Ask only consequential gaps.
I will paste selected conversations or a memory summary. Distil the context relevant to my goal, show candidate patterns with examples, and ask only what remains unclear.
Check whether the Psychology MCP is connected. If not, guide me through secure setup first; never ask me to paste a password, token, or credential.
